request.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural. One clear real-world documentary photograph for a Spanish-speaking beginner learning English, full-bleed 3:2 landscape. Natural material grain, believable optics and daylight, realistic anatomy and hands. NOT an illustration, collage, split panel, cutout or app screenshot. This is a two-person conversation: who is speaking must be obvious from gaze, open mouth, posture and hand gesture alone. No speech bubbles, arrows, halos, labels, captions, logos, watermarks or readable words anywhere, including on books and paper. Both people fully visible from head to at least the knees, faces and hands inside the central safe area, with calm background and no competing people.

Use case: identity-preserve. Image 1 establishes the exact faces, hair and clothing of Ana (long dark wavy hair, sage-green overshirt over a white top, jeans) and Luis (short dark curly hair, navy T-shirt, khaki trousers). Create a brand-new photograph in a different place: a bright community-center reading corner with a low grey sofa, wooden bookshelves and a large window, soft afternoon light. Ana sits on the sofa holding an open paperback book in both hands at chest height, eyes on the pages, clearly reading. Luis stands one step away on her right, body and face turned toward her, eyebrows raised with a curious friendly expression, mouth slightly open mid-question, one relaxed open palm extended toward Ana in a natural asking gesture. Luis is unmistakably the one asking; Ana has not looked up yet. The open book pages face Ana and show only blurred grey text lines, never readable words. Medium-wide camera at eye level, both people large in frame.

cost.basis: Reported usage at uncached list rates; before tax or discounts, not an invoice.

agent_review.notes: Ana (sage overshirt, white top, jeans, long wavy hair) sits on a grey sofa reading an open paperback, eyes on the page. Luis (navy tee, khaki trousers, curly hair) stands turned to her with an open palm, raised brows and open mouth: he is clearly asking. Book text is illegible grey lines; no readable words. Full-bleed 3:2, both people to the knees.

change_control.reason: Approved 3.3 addition: What are you doing? needs new speaker-view scenes before 3.9 and 3.10 may assess it.
